title: Reading Cloud & Branch Connector activation status

prose.text: Cloud & Branch Connector stages changes like ZIA, but its status read does not answer in ZIA's terms. The activate calls themselves are in [[cloud-connector.api.activation-wire]].

prose.label: Reading the status.
prose.text: {{no-zia-status-vocabulary}} What each status value means is not documented {{gap:status-meanings}}.

prose.label: Activation nobody triggered.
prose.text: Whether Cloud & Branch Connector also activates on its own, as ZIA does when a session ends, is only partly settled {{gap:session-autoactivation}}. The Python SDK says a ZTW session, like ZIA's, needs an explicit logout to activate staged configurations: [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.client-configuration:sdk-says-logout-activates]]. The ZIA behavior is [[zia.terraform.activation-methods:session-end-autoactivation]].

checks.do: Whether orgEditStatus shows edits present, and which admins' states in adminStatusMap are not done, rather than looking for PENDING.
Whether the last activation status names a timer or autosync activation when changes went live without an activate call.

no-zia-status-vocabulary.statement: The Cloud & Branch Connector status read does not return ZIA's ACTIVE, PENDING or INPROGRESS: it returns an organization policy edit status (EDITS_CLEARED, EDITS_PRESENT or EDITS_ACTIVATED_ON_RESTART), the organization's last activation status, an admin activation status (ADM_LOGGED_IN through ADM_EXPIRED) and a per-admin status map, so a pending-change check reads the edit status instead.
no-zia-status-vocabulary.conditions: The value lists come from the specification's enums; that EDITS_PRESENT is the pending state is read from the names, which no source defines (gap status-meanings).

status-meanings.title: What the Cloud & Branch Connector activation status values mean
status-meanings.detail: The specification lists the values of orgEditStatus, orgLastActivateStatus and adminActivateStatus with one-line field descriptions and no per-value meaning. Which value shows staged but unactivated changes, what EDITS_ACTIVATED_ON_RESTART and ADM_EXPIRED mean, and how adminStatusMap is keyed are not documented.
status-meanings.blocks: telling from a status read whether Cloud & Branch Connector changes are still pending

session-autoactivation.title: Whether Cloud & Branch Connector activates pending changes on its own
session-autoactivation.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "The captured CBC sources do not establish whether ZIA's session-boundary autoactivation behavior also applies to CBC." The Python SDK's code comment and 1.5.9 changelog say ZTW, like ZIA, needs the explicit logout to activate staged configurations (cloud-connector.sdk-python.client-configuration:sdk-says-logout-activates), which points to activation at session end; no vendor help or API page states it, says whether a session timeout does the same, or explains the last-activation values CAC_ACTV_AUTOSYNC and CAC_ACTV_TIMER and the edit status EDITS_ACTIVATED_ON_RESTART.
session-autoactivation.blocks: predicting whether staged Cloud & Branch Connector changes go live without an activate call
